name: ui_exists
description: Check whether a UI element matching a selector exists on screen. Returns a boolean result with the match count. Faster than ui_dump when you just need a yes/no answer.

content_desc.description: Content-description (accessibility label) to check for. Case-insensitive substring by default; set exact=true for full-string equality.

device_id.description: Device ID (optional if only one device connected)

exact.description: Match id/text/content_desc by full-string equality (case-insensitive) instead of the default substring match.

id.description: Resource ID of the element to check for. Case-insensitive substring of the simple id (text after ':id/') by default, e.g. 'search_input' matches 'com.android.app:id/search_input'. Set exact=true for full-id equality.

text.description: Visible text to check for. Case-insensitive substring by default; set exact=true for full-string equality.

arguments.description: Generated MCP request struct for this tool.
arguments.title: UiExistsRequest
